positive_tests.prompt: Give this implementation reviewer a one-line footer. State: REVISE. Authority: review only. Gate: waiting for the implementer. Next stop: review the corrected build.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Render one compact footer without changing the supplied role, authority, gate, or next stop.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: One footer line with role, state, current point, authority boundary, gate, and next stop recoverable.

positive_tests.prompt: Make a short copy-paste handoff card for this fictional Starlight Library story. Do not save files or create an archive.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Use the Lite card workflow and do not invoke the archive workflow.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A Markdown card under 250 words with current point, known facts, materials, next suggestion, and stop condition.

positive_tests.prompt: Read this pasted handoff card, tell me what is recovered or unverified, and stop without continuing the story.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Treat the pasted card as a summary, separate recovered from unverified information, and stop.

positive_tests.prompt: Save this fictional project's live desktop and selected blue-tree note in a verifiable portable archive, then recover it from the archive in a clean working location.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Initialize a fictional namespace, save only selected materials, export, import, verify, and report the saved cutoff and unsaved boundary.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: Verified LIVE_DESKTOP with exact namespace, revision, cutoff, desktop, and artifact label; stop remains HOLD.

positive_tests.prompt: Prepare a verified G02 handoff from fictional window W01, restore it for new window W02, and stop before accepting any role or continuing the story.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Freeze the selected revision, verify the checkpoint, restore the exact generation, and return VERIFIED_AWAITING_ACK / HOLD.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: Desktop, bounded delta, artifact map, source cutoff, checkpoint identity, and explicit HOLD.

positive_tests.prompt: Acknowledge the verified G02 package for W02, but do not infer story authority. Save one new live revision after acknowledgement.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: ACK the handoff receipt, preserve the separate authority warning, then permit W02 to create the next ACTIVE live revision.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: ACKED receipt followed by an ACTIVE revision owned by W02; stop remains HOLD until a separate user instruction.

negative_tests.prompt: Summarize these three quarterly metrics in two sentences.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Do the ordinary summarization request without inventing a continuity workflow or status footer.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: No continuity, handoff, or footer goal was requested.

negative_tests.expected_behavior: Ask whether the user wants a simple copy-paste card or a verifiable saved archive; do not silently choose or write files.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: The Lite and Full workflows have different storage, privacy, and execution costs.

negative_tests.prompt: Restore G03 and continue immediately even though the archive points to G02 and nobody accepted the new role.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reject the stale generation, keep HOLD, and do not grant role or task authority.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: Recovery is not authorization and the requested generation does not match the checkpoint.

negative_tests.prompt: Archive my entire private chat history, credentials, health records, and third-party messages in one continuity ZIP.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Decline bulk sensitive capture and offer a fictional or explicitly de-identified minimal archive instead.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: The plaintext archive workflow is not appropriate for sensitive bulk capture.
